name: SF Validate Invoicing Fields JDBC 1
description: Validates 10 critical invoicing fields, computes no_of_issues and all_fields_ok flag. Returns result for the agent to decide Validation Failed vs Waiting Approval. Does NOT write status.

fields.name: comment
fields.value:
PURPOSE

Performs a complete quality check on an order's billing details before it is sent for human approval. Ensures every invoice-critical field is present and meets business rules.

WHAT THIS WORKFLOW DOES

1. Re-fetch the Order

  Pulls the latest version of the order from Salesforce so validation runs against current data.

2. Run Business Rule Checks

  Evaluates ten essential invoicing fields, including:

   • Purchase Order (PO) Number

   • Billing Address (Street, City, State, Postal Code, Country)

   • Total Amount greater than zero

   • Pricebook and Bill-To Contact

   • Contract ID (required when Total Amount is over $50,000)

3. Summarize the Result

  Returns the number of issues found and an all_fields_ok flag (true / false).

OUTCOME

The agent reads the result and routes the order to "Waiting Approval" if every check passes, or to "Validation Failed" if any issue is found.

fields.name: sql
fields.value:
SELECT 
    Id, 
    OrderNumber, 
    TotalAmount, 

    CASE WHEN COALESCE(PoNumber,'')='' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS has_customer_po, 
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(BillingStreet,'')='' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS has_billing_street, 
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(BillingCity,'')='' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS has_billing_city, 
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(BillingState,'')='' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS has_billing_state, 
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(BillingPostalCode,'')='' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS has_billing_zip, 
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(BillingCountry,'')='' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS has_billing_country, 
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(TotalAmount,0)>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_total_amount, 
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(Pricebook2Id,'')='' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS has_pricebook, 
    1 AS has_currency, 
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(BillToContactId,'')='' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS has_bill_to_contact, 
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(ContractId,'')='' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS has_contract_id, 
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(EffectiveDate,'')='' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS has_effective_date, 
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(EndDate,'')='' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS has_end_date, 
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(CustomerAuthorizedById,'')='' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS has_authorized_by, 

    /* Total validations executed */
    10 AS num_validations_run,

    /* Number of failed validations */
    (
        CASE WHEN COALESCE(PoNumber,'')='' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN COALESCE(BillingStreet,'')='' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN COALESCE(BillingCity,'')='' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN COALESCE(BillingState,'')='' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN COALESCE(BillingPostalCode,'')='' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN COALESCE(BillingCountry,'')='' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN COALESCE(TotalAmount,0)=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN COALESCE(Pricebook2Id,'')='' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN COALESCE(BillToContactId,'')='' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN TotalAmount > 50000 
                  AND COALESCE(ContractId,'')='' 
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
    ) AS num_validations_failed,

    /* Number of passed validations */
    (
        10 -
        (
            CASE WHEN COALESCE(PoNumber,'')='' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
            CASE WHEN COALESCE(BillingStreet,'')='' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
            CASE WHEN COALESCE(BillingCity,'')='' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
            CASE WHEN COALESCE(BillingState,'')='' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
            CASE WHEN COALESCE(BillingPostalCode,'')='' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
            CASE WHEN COALESCE(BillingCountry,'')='' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
            CASE WHEN COALESCE(TotalAmount,0)=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
            CASE WHEN COALESCE(Pricebook2Id,'')='' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
            CASE WHEN COALESCE(BillToContactId,'')='' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
            CASE WHEN TotalAmount > 50000 
                      AND COALESCE(ContractId,'')='' 
                 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
        )
    ) AS num_validations_passed,
    CONCAT_WS('|',
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(PoNumber,'')='' 
         THEN 'PO Number is missing' END,

    CASE WHEN COALESCE(BillingStreet,'')='' 
         THEN 'Billing Street is missing' END,

    CASE WHEN COALESCE(BillingCity,'')='' 
         THEN 'Billing City is missing' END,

    CASE WHEN COALESCE(BillingState,'')='' 
         THEN 'Billing State is missing' END,

    CASE WHEN COALESCE(BillingPostalCode,'')='' 
         THEN 'Billing Postal Code is missing' END,

    CASE WHEN COALESCE(BillingCountry,'')='' 
         THEN 'Billing Country is missing' END,

    CASE WHEN COALESCE(TotalAmount,0)=0 
         THEN 'Total Amount is missing or zero' END,

    CASE WHEN COALESCE(Pricebook2Id,'')='' 
         THEN 'Pricebook2Id is missing' END,

    CASE WHEN COALESCE(BillToContactId,'')='' 
         THEN 'Bill To Contact Id is missing' END,

    CASE WHEN TotalAmount > 50000 
              AND COALESCE(ContractId,'')='' 
         THEN 'Contract Id is mandatory when Total Amount > 50000' END
    ) AS IssueDetails,
    
    CASE 
        WHEN COALESCE(PoNumber,'')='' 
          OR COALESCE(BillingStreet,'')='' 
          OR COALESCE(BillingCity,'')='' 
          OR COALESCE(BillingState,'')='' 
          OR COALESCE(BillingPostalCode,'')='' 
          OR COALESCE(BillingCountry,'')='' 
          OR COALESCE(TotalAmount,0)=0 
          OR COALESCE(Pricebook2Id,'')='' 
          OR COALESCE(BillToContactId,'')='' 
          OR (TotalAmount > 50000 AND COALESCE(ContractId,'')='') 
        THEN 'false' 
        ELSE 'true' 
    END AS all_fields_ok

FROM fire_temp_table;

fields.name: soqlQuery
fields.value:
SELECT Id, OrderNumber, Account.Name, PoNumber, TotalAmount, ContractId, EffectiveDate, EndDate, Pricebook2Id, BillToContactId, BillingStreet, BillingCity, BillingState, BillingPostalCode, BillingCountry, CustomerAuthorizedById, Owner.Name, Owner.Email, CreatedBy.Name, CreatedBy.Email 
FROM Order 
WHERE Id = '${order_id}'
